metadata.description: Mods for the Claude desktop app's Code tab: sidebar status sections, a usage band above the prompt and an Environment pane.

plugins.name: chat-status
plugins.description: Files the current chat in the desktop sidebar by what Claude is doing: Working, Waiting, or Needs your answer.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Shows the plan's session and weekly usage above the prompt: loading bars, reset countdowns and a pace estimate.

plugins.name: environment-pane
plugins.description: An Environment pane beside the chat: Remote Control, a browsable project tree with a pixel Claude where it works, the context as hoverable columns, and the connectors.
